inlines.v: ME'DIAL, adjective [Latin medius, middle.] Mean; noting a mean or average. Medial alligation, is a method of finding the mean rate or value of a mixture consisting of two or more ingredients of different quantities and values. In this case, the quantity and value of each ingredient are given.
